transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well, I came in because... I kind of lost my temper at work recently. I snapped on a board call over a small question about the facility budget. Just completely blew up over nothing. And, well, that is not how I run my company, and it's definitely not how I treat people. So I figured I should come in and see someone about it.
Has losing your temper like this happened before, or was this an isolated incident?

No, it really hasn't. That's... that's exactly why I decided to come in. It was an isolated incident. I mean, sure, running a business gets stressful and I can be firm with people when I need to be, but just completely losing control and yelling? That's never been my style. I haven't done anything like that before.
Apart from that outburst, how has your mood been generally over the past few weeks?

Honestly, it's been... well, just flat. That's the best way I can describe it. Things that usually settle me down, like working on a chess problem, going over my hiking notes, or even just having dinner with my wife... they all just feel flat right now. I mean, I know I should enjoy them, but I just can't seem to get there.
About how long have you been feeling this sense of flatness and lack of enjoyment?
It's been about six days now. Yeah, six days. Basically, it started right after the explosion and fire we had during the facility walkthrough.
Did you hit your head or suffer an injury to your head during the explosion?
No, I didn't. I mean, I got knocked off my feet by the blast, but I didn't hit my head. No concussions or anything like that. Just some scrapes and bruises.
Since the explosion, have unwanted memories or images of the event been popping into your mind?

Yeah, they have. It's... well, it usually happens when I'm trying to work. I'll be right in the middle of a phone call, or just sitting there looking at some numbers, and the blast and that fire by the loading area just jump back into my head. It's like a bad film I didn't ask to see, just playing out of nowhere.
When did the explosion at the facility take place?
Like I said a minute ago, it was about six days ago. That's when we were doing the walkthrough and the explosion and fire happened.
